title: Chapter 303 Traveling In The Fairyland
content:
Chapter 303 Traveling In The Fairyland

Everyone was shocked when they heard An Lingyun's words.

No wonder the dean didn't let them go directly, so that's how it was.

There was a brief silence in the meeting.

Even Li Changqing, who was yelling to lead the team in person at the beginning, lowered his head and said nothing.

For a moment, the atmosphere in the conference hall became a little depressed.

The question now is how to make students entering the ancient battlefield not only get training and opportunities, but also be able to come out alive.

This is not a simple matter.

Even the little guys on the academy's list of monsters are probably not absolutely sure.

After all, that is an ancient battlefield.

It is no exaggeration to say that he died in the ancient battlefield and still has some remaining existence until today. In those days, he was definitely one of the most terrifying groups of strong men in the fairy world.

Even if the endless years have passed, the remaining trace of power cannot be solved in the early stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Just when everyone didn't know how to deal with it, Tan Songci suddenly became slightly stunned, and then his face looked ecstatic.

"Dean, Tang Hao is back!"

Tang Hao!

As soon as these words were spoken, the other people also looked lit up.

An Lingyun said directly: "Take him here right now."

"Yes, Dean."

Tan Songci did not hesitate and stood up and disappeared into the hall.

"Haha, since Tang Hao is back, that's easy to say."

"Yes, I didn't expect that Tang Hao would come back at this time."

Tang Hao, a disciple under Tan Songci.

The 18th place in the Monster List, the second level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

There is nothing more suitable to enter the ancient battlefield than him.

Inner courtyard.

With a hearty laughter sounded.

Immediately afterwards, a young man wearing a long robe with a beautiful face but with a somewhat resolute face stepped on the void and slowly approached the inner courtyard.

A terrifying aura kept gushing out like a flood of beasts.

The entire inner courtyard was shrouded in its powerful pressure.

"Then, who is that? So arrogant?"

"Arrogant, I really have the strength."

"Wait, that seems to be Senior Brother Tang Hao!"

Tang Hao!

Everyone was slightly stunned, and then they immediately took a deep breath.

Tang Hao is actually Tang Hao.

The 18th place in the monster list, it is absolutely terrifying monster.

For a moment, the entire inner courtyard was in full bloom.

Countless students came out of seclusion, looking up at Tang Hao standing proudly in the void.

Several other demons in the academy also looked at Tang Hao in the void with a serious expression.

The list of monsters is extremely valuable.

There is basically a watershed between each ranking.

What's more, Tang Hao, who is so many names taller than them.

Tang Hao was so energetic that he was wearing a long robe without wind, and his whole face was flushed. It can be seen that he had gained a lot in the years he went out to practice.

Tang Hao looked at Tiandi Academy, shook his head slightly, and sighed, "Not even my Academy, there is no glory at all."

The sound was not loud, but it kept echoing from the academy.

When everyone heard this, the corners of their mouths twitched slightly.

I wanted to refute, but I couldn't speak.

Who makes people have strength?

At this time, Tang Hao chanted loudly again: "I have been traveling to the fairy world for decades and seeing the prosperity of the world. Once I was promoted to the third level of emperor, I will know that I am me today."

The quiet sound of poetry is endless.

Everyone looked at Tang Hao in the void and couldn't help but be slightly stunned.

Three-level emperor?

The next moment, a powerful aura surged out from Tang Hao's body again.

Rumble!

The void began to tremble wildly in this breath.

With a click, a breath of the third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm overflowed from Tang Hao's body, but in a flash, it disappeared into the void again.

The third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm!

Tang Hao actually broke through!

At this moment, the entire Tiandi Academy was silent and the needle could be heard.

Everyone stared blankly at Tang Hao standing with his hands behind his back in the void, as if everything had been held in his palm.

For a moment, everyone was a little lost in their sight.

Countless female students looked even more rosy, and the soft water in their eyes seemed to be overflowing.

"Damn it, he pretended."

In the crowd, Dongku looked at Tang Hao who was full of energy in the void and gritted his teeth.

However, he only dared to say in a low voice that he would definitely not be able to beat him. The gap was already big, but now that he has broken through again, let alone.

On the side, Ye Yan was here, not talking, but his face was solemn.

In the void, Tang Hao still did not move.

But at this moment, my heart was filled with joy.

After waiting for so many years, it’s finally time to show off again.

Really, it's cool!

Tang Hao breathed gently and was about to speak.

A voice suddenly came from a distance.

"Stupid brat, stop pretending, follow me quickly!"

Hearing this, Tang Hao couldn't help frowning slightly.

He hates people interrupting him when he is pretending.

"Who doesn't have eyes,"

call out!

The space trembled and a familiar old man appeared in front of him.

When Tang Hao saw the visitor, he was shocked.

"teacher,,"

Before he finished speaking, Tan Songci directly lifted Tang Hao with one hand and disappeared from the spot in an instant.

Everyone:...

In the conference hall.

With a plop.

Tang Hao was put on the ground by Tan Songci, but because of his speed, Tang Hao failed to stand firm and fell directly to bite the mud.

"Ouch!"

"Dean, I've brought it."

Tan Songci bowed to An Lingyun, who was sitting in the c position, and then returned to his seat.

The others were looking at Tang Hao who fell to the ground.

Is this the disciple of Tan Songci, Tang Hao, who is ranked 18th on the Monster List?

He is indeed a handsome talent.

At this time, Tang Hao also realized something, cursed in his heart, and quickly got up.

"Student Tang Hao, I have met the dean and the mentors."

There are certain etiquettes that should be there.

It is in sharp contrast with the arrogant attitude he just entered the academy.

Tan Songci sighed slightly as he looked at the student who taught him.

As a student, I am good at everything, but I am too arrogant.

If not, the achievements would probably be higher.

It seems that I have to find someone to cure him.

Tan Songci thought so in his heart.

"Tang Hao, have you been parading the fairy world over the years?"

An Lingyun looked at Tang Hao and asked.

Upon hearing this, Tang Hao nodded, "Yes, the path of cultivation is about the mind and nature. Students have seen all the warmth and coldness of the world along the way, and they have gained a little from the mind and nature."

Others are fighting wildly to strengthen themselves.

But Tang Hao did the opposite and consolidated his mind through traveling.

Now, his cultivation has really improved, and after decades, he has broken through to the third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Of course, his biggest gain was the growth of his mind.

This is crucial to his future cultivation.

Hearing Tang Hao's answer, An Lingyun nodded slightly.

A child can teach.

But on the side, Tan Songci had a blank expression on his face.

He knew better than anyone else, and he said this in front of the dean and the supervisor.

If you are in front of others, you will either show off or sneer.

Haha, you deserve to know?
